parts.text:
Explore the Electron desktop app at /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W. I need a thorough understanding of the renderer, shared, and smoke layers, plus deployment/CI.

Focus on:
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/renderer (components, browser, channels, hooks, lib)
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/shared (and toolchains/)
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/smoke
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/native/windows-managed-process-helper (Rust helper)
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/electron-builder.yml
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/.github/workflows/build-desktop.yml

Report on:
1. Renderer responsibilities: React 19 + Vite, how it talks to host via preload bridge, main workspace UI (sessions, files, processes, browser) 
2. Shared pure functions and toolchain shared modules
3. Smoke tests purpose
4. Windows managed process helper: what it does, its protocol, integrity checks
5. Packaging/electron-builder config: targets, artifacts
6. CI build workflow: build matrix, signing, release assets

List concrete file paths and important symbols with bounded evidence spans. Report concisely but comprehensively. Do NOT write any files.
I'll explore the Electron desktop app systematically. Let me start by understanding the overall structure and then dive into each area.

138: fn normalized_environment(value: Value) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>> {
139:     let Value::Object(values) = value else {
140:         return Err(HelperError::protocol("HELPER_INVALID_FRAME"));
141:     };
142:     if values.len() > MAX_ENVIRONMENT_ENTRIES {
143:         return Err(HelperError::protocol("TARGET_ENVIRONMENT_TOO_LARGE"));
144:     }
145:     let mut folded = BTreeMap::<String, (String, String)>::new();
146:     let mut serialized_bytes = 2_usize;
147:     for (key, value) in values {
148:         let Value::String(value) = value else {
149:             return Err(HelperError::protocol("HELPER_INVALID_FRAME"));
150:         };
151:         if key.is_empty()
152:             || key.contains(['\0', '='])
153:             || value.contains('\0')
154:             || key.encode_utf16().count() + value.encode_utf16().count() + 2 > 32_767
155:         {
156:             return Err(HelperError::protocol("TARGET_ENVIRONMENT_TOO_LARGE"));
157:         }
158:         let comparable = key.to_lowercase();
159:         if comparable == "electron_run_as_node" {
160:             continue;
161:         }
162:         serialized_bytes = serialized_bytes
163:             .saturating_add(crate::protocol::json_escape(&key).len())
164:             .saturating_add(crate::protocol::json_escape(&value).len())
165:             .saturating_add(2);
166:         if serialized_bytes > MAX_ENVIRONMENT_JSON_BYTES {
167:             return Err(HelperError::protocol("TARGET_ENVIRONMENT_TOO_LARGE"));
168:         }
169:         if folded.insert(comparable, (key, value)).is_some() {
170:             return Err(HelperError::protocol("HELPER_INVALID_FRAME"));
171:         }
172:     }
173:     Ok(folded.into_values().collect())
174: }

369: pub fn build_environment_block(environment: &BTreeMap<String, String>) -> Result<Vec<u16>> {
370:     let mut pairs: Vec<_> = environment.iter().collect();
371:     pairs.sort_by_key(|left| left.0.to_lowercase());
372:     let mut block = Vec::new();
373:     for (key, value) in pairs {
374:         block.extend(key.encode_utf16());
375:         block.push(u16::from(b'='));
376:         block.extend(value.encode_utf16());
377:         block.push(0);
378:     }
379:     block.push(0);
380:     if block.len().saturating_mul(2) > MAX_ENVIRONMENT_BLOCK_BYTES {
381:         return Err(HelperError::protocol("TARGET_ENVIRONMENT_TOO_LARGE"));
382:     }
383:     Ok(block)
384: }

386: pub fn quote_windows_argument(value: &str) -> String {
387:     if !value.is_empty()
388:         && !value
389:             .chars()
390:             .any(|character| character.is_whitespace() || character == '"')
391:     {
392:         return value.to_owned();
393:     }
394:     let mut result = String::from("\"");
395:     let mut slashes = 0;
396:     for character in value.chars() {
397:         if character == '\\' {
398:             slashes += 1;
399:             continue;
400:         }
401:         if character == '"' {
402:             result.extend(std::iter::repeat_n('\\', slashes * 2 + 1));
403:             result.push('"');
404:             slashes = 0;
405:             continue;
406:         }
407:         result.extend(std::iter::repeat_n('\\', slashes));
408:         slashes = 0;
409:         result.push(character);
410:     }
411:     result.extend(std::iter::repeat_n('\\', slashes * 2));
412:     result.push('"');
413:     result
414: }

416: pub fn build_command_line(
417:     executable: &str,
418:     argv_prefix: &[String],
419:     command: &str,
420: ) -> Result<Vec<u16>> {
421:     let arguments = std::iter::once(executable)
422:         .chain(argv_prefix.iter().map(String::as_str))
423:         .chain(["-c", command])
424:         .map(quote_windows_argument)
425:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
426:         .join(" ");
427:     let mut wide: Vec<u16> = arguments.encode_utf16().collect();
428:     if wide.len() >= 32_767 {
429:         return Err(HelperError::protocol("TARGET_COMMAND_LINE_TOO_LONG"));
430:     }
431:     wide.push(0);
432:     Ok(wide)
433: }

434:                 `${source} (${String(version)}) does not match package.json (${packageJson.version})`,
435:               );
436:             }
437:           }
438: 
439:           if (process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME !== expectedTag) {
440:             throw new Error(
441:               `Release tag ${process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME} must exactly match ${expectedTag}`,

545:           function findUpdateConfigs(directory, matches = []) {
546:             for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
547:               const entryPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
548:               if (entry.isDirectory()) {
549:                 findUpdateConfigs(entryPath, matches);
550:               } else if (
551:                 entry.isFile() &&
552:                 entry.name === "app-update.yml" &&
553:                 entryPath
554:                   .split(path.sep)
555:                   .join("/")
556:                   .endsWith(".app/Contents/Resources/app-update.yml")

562:           }

564:           function readScalar(document, key) {

566:               new RegExp(`^\\s*${key}\\s*:\\s*([^#\\r\\n]+)`, "mi"),
567:             );
568:             if (!match) {
569:               throw new Error(`Missing ${key}`);
570:             }
571: 
572:             const value = match[1].trim();
573:             if (
574:               (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) ||
575:               (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))
576:             ) {
577:               return value.slice(1, -1);
578:             }
579:             return value;
580:           }

598:               }

609:               ],
610:               [

612:                 /https?:\/\/[^/\s:@]+:[^@\s/]+@/i,
613:               ],
614:               [
615:                 "authorization value",

617:               ],
618:               [
619:                 "GitHub token",

621:               ],
622:             ];
623: 
624:             for (const [label, pattern] of forbidden) {
625:               if (pattern.test(document)) {
626:                 throw new Error(`${file}: contains a forbidden ${label}`);
627:               }
628:             }
629: 
630:             console.log(`Validated ${file}`);
631:           }

633:           const configs = findUpdateConfigs("dist").sort();

635:             throw new Error(
636:               `Expected two packaged macOS app-update.yml files, found ${configs.length}`,
637:             );
638:           }
639:           configs.forEach(verifyUpdateConfig);

782:         shell: bash
783:         run: |
784:           node <<'NODE'
785:           const fs = require("node:fs");
786:           const path = require("node:path");
787: 
788:           function findUpdateConfigs(directory, matches = []) {
789:             for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
790:               const entryPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
791:               if (entry.isDirectory()) {
792:                 findUpdateConfigs(entryPath, matches);
793:               } else if (
794:                 entry.isFile() &&
795:                 entry.name === "app-update.yml" &&
796:                 /\/win(?:-[^/]+)?-unpacked\/resources\/app-update\.yml$/i.test(
797:                   `/${entryPath.split(path.sep).join("/")}`,
798:                 )
799:               ) {
800:                 matches.push(entryPath);
801:               }
802:             }
803:             return matches;
804:           }
805: 
806:           function readScalar(document, key) {
807:             const match = document.match(
808:               new RegExp(`^\\s*${key}\\s*:\\s*([^#\\r\\n]+)`, "mi"),
809:             );
810:             if (!match) {
811:               throw new Error(`Missing ${key}`);
812:             }
813: 
814:             const value = match[1].trim();

816:               (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) ||
817:               (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))

848:               [

851:               ],
852:               [
853:                 "credential-bearing URL",
854:                 /https?:\/\/[^/\s:@]+:[^@\s/]+@/i,
855:               ],
856:               [
857:                 "authorization value",
858:                 /\b(?:Basic|Bearer)\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/_.=-]{8,}/i,
859:               ],
860:               [
861:                 "GitHub token",
862:                 /\b(?:gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,})\b/i,
863:               ],
864:             ];
865: 
866:             for (const [label, pattern] of forbidden) {
867:               if (pattern.test(document)) {
868:                 throw new Error(`${file}: contains a forbidden ${label}`);
869:               }
870:             }

872:             console.log(`Validated ${file}`);
873:           }

875:           const configs = findUpdateConfigs("dist").sort();

877:             throw new Error(
878:               `Expected one packaged Windows app-update.yml file, found ${configs.length}`,
879:             );
880:           }

886:               );

888:             verifyUpdateConfig(file);
889:           }

898:           sbom="dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-Windows-x64-${version}.cdx.json"

display.text:
name: Build desktop apps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: desktop-build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}

jobs:
  test-platforms:
    name: Tests (${{ matrix.name }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Linux x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: macOS arm64
            runner: macos-15
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: macOS x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
            timeout_minutes: 25
          - name: Windows x64
            runner: windows-2025
            timeout_minutes: 45
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout_minutes }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Install pinned Windows cross toolchain (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cargo install cargo-xwin --locked --version 0.23.1
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends clang-18 lld-18 llvm-18

      - name: Compile-check Windows helper with cargo-xwin (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: npm run build:windows-helper

      - name: Install pinned Rust supply-chain gates (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-audit --locked --version 0.22.2
          cargo install cargo-deny --locked --version 0.20.2

      - name: Install Electron binary (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npx install-electron --no

      - name: Validate Windows managed process helper
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input Flask==3.1.0 fastapi==0.128.0 uvicorn==0.40.0
          cargo fmt --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- -D warnings
          cargo test --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cargo audit --file native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.lock --deny warnings
          cargo deny --manifest-path native/windows-managed-process-helper/Cargo.toml --config native/windows-managed-process-helper/deny.toml --locked check
          npm run check:windows-helper-reproducibility
          $env:PI_WINDOWS_HELPER_HANDLE_LOOPS = "100"
          npm run test:windows-managed-helper
          npm run test:managed-process-workflows
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_DURATION_MS = "60000"
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_PROCESSES = "8"
          $env:PI_MANAGED_FLOOD_STREAMS = "both"
          npm run test:managed-process-flood

      - name: Run unit and handler tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run cross-platform quality checks (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          npm run format:check
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm run check:dependencies
          npm run check:contract
          npm run check:pi-compat
          npm run check:toolchain-contract
          npm run check:toolchain-catalog
          npm run check:browser-i18n

  windows-frameworks:
    name: Windows managed framework acceptance
    runs-on: windows-2025
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      CI: "1"
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
      STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Set up pinned Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Build authoritative Windows helper
        run: npm run check:windows-helper-reproducibility

      - name: Prepare pinned framework fixtures
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $nodeRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "framework-node-root"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $nodeRoot -Force | Out-Null
          Push-Location $nodeRoot
          try {
            npm init -y | Out-Null
            npm install --save-exact --no-audit --no-fund next@16.3.2 react@19.2.4 react-dom@19.2.4 storybook@10.5.10 @storybook/react-vite@10.5.10 vite@6.4.3 typescript@5.9.3
          } finally {
            Pop-Location
          }
          $springZip = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "spring-boot-4.1.1-fixture.zip"
          $springUrl = "https://start.spring.io/starter.zip?type=maven-project&language=java&bootVersion=4.1.1&baseDir=spring-boot-4.1.1-fixture&groupId=com.example&artifactId=fixture&name=SpringFixture&packageName=com.example.fixture&packaging=jar&javaVersion=21&dependencies=web"
          curl.exe --fail --location --retry 3 --output $springZip $springUrl
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Spring Initializr download exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $springZip -DestinationPath $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $springRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "spring-boot-4.1.1-fixture"
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $springRoot "mvnw.cmd"))) { throw "Spring wrapper is missing" }
          "PI_FRAMEWORK_NODE_ROOT=$nodeRoot" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "PI_SPRING_BOOT_FIXTURE=$springRoot" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "PI_JAVA_EXECUTABLE=$((Get-Command java).Source)" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "PI_MAVEN_USER_HOME=$(Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'maven-user-home-3.9.16')" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run real managed framework matrix
        run: npm run test:managed-process-frameworks

  quality:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Install Electron binary
        run: npx install-electron --no

      - name: Prepare verified bundled search tools
        run: npm run prepare:bundled-tools -- --target linux-x64

      - name: Configure Electron sandbox
        run: |
          sudo chown root:root node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox
          sudo chmod 4755 node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox

      - name: Run full verification
        run: xvfb-run --auto-servernum npm run verify

  package:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    if: github.ref_type != 'tag'
    needs: [quality, test-platforms, windows-frameworks]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: macOS arm64
            runner: macos-15
            platform: mac
            targets: dmg zip
            arch: arm64
            tool_target: darwin-arm64
            artifact: pi-desktop-macos-arm64
          - name: macOS Intel x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
            platform: mac
            targets: dmg zip
            arch: x64
            tool_target: darwin-x64
            artifact: pi-desktop-macos-x64
          - name: Windows x64
            runner: windows-2025
            platform: win
            targets: nsis
            arch: x64
            tool_target: win32-x64
            artifact: pi-desktop-windows-x64
          - name: Linux x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux
            targets: AppImage
            arch: x64
            tool_target: linux-x64
            artifact: pi-desktop-linux-x64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: "false"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Electron runtime for Windows acceptance
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npx install-electron --no

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.96.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --profile minimal --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build

      - name: Rebuild authoritative Windows helper for packaging
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: npm run check:windows-helper-reproducibility

      - name: Run Windows managed process integration
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input Flask==3.1.0 fastapi==0.128.0 uvicorn==0.40.0
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          npm run test:windows-managed-helper

  release-contract:
    name: Validate release contract
    if: github.ref_type == 'tag' && startsWith(github.ref_name, 'v')
    needs: [quality, test-platforms, windows-frameworks]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Verify tag and package versions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_commit="$(git rev-parse "${GITHUB_SHA}^{commit}")"
          git fetch --no-tags origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_commit" origin/main; then
            echo "Release tag must point to a commit contained in main" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          node <<'NODE'
          const packageJson = require("./package.json");
          const packageLock = require("./package-lock.json");

          if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(packageJson.version)) {
            throw new Error(
              `Stable release versions must use x.y.z without a prerelease suffix: ${packageJson.version}`,
            );
          }

          const expectedTag = `v${packageJson.version}`;
          const versions = [
            ["package-lock.json.version", packageLock.version],
            [
              'package-lock.json.packages[""].version',
              packageLock.packages?.[""]?.version,
            ],
          ];

          for (const [source, version] of versions) {
            if (version !== packageJson.version) {
              throw new Error(
                `${source} (${String(version)}) does not match package.json (${packageJson.version})`,
              );
            }
          }

          if (process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME !== expectedTag) {
            throw new Error(
              `Release tag ${process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME} must exactly match ${expectedTag}`,
            );
          }

          console.log(`Validated release ${expectedTag}`);
          NODE

      - name: Refuse an existing public release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if is_draft="$(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null)"; then
            if [ "$is_draft" != "true" ]; then
              echo "Release $GITHUB_REF_NAME is already public; published assets are immutable" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Verify managed runtime catalog against upstream releases
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npm run check:toolchain-catalog:upstream

  release-macos:
    name: Sign and notarize macOS
    if: github.ref_type == 'tag' && startsWith(github.ref_name, 'v')
    needs: [release-contract]
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 90
    environment:
      name: release
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build, sign, and notarize macOS
        env:
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.MAC_CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAC_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: npm run dist:mac:notarized -- --arm64 --x64

      - name: Verify both signed and notarized apps
        env:
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          find_app_for_arch() {
            local expected_arch="$1"
            local app binary
            while IFS= read -r -d '' app; do
              binary="$app/Contents/MacOS/Pi Agent Desktop"
              if [ -f "$binary" ] && lipo -archs "$binary" | grep -qw "$expected_arch"; then
                printf '%s\n' "$app"
                return 0
              fi
            done < <(find dist -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'Pi Agent Desktop.app' -print0)
            return 1
          }

          verify_app() {
            local app="$1"
            local expected_arch="$2"
            local renderer="$app/Contents/Frameworks/Pi Agent Desktop Helper (Renderer).app"
            local entitlements

            echo "Verifying $expected_arch app: $app"
            codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$app"
            xcrun stapler validate "$app"
            spctl --assess --type execute --verbose=4 "$app"
            codesign -dv --verbose=4 "$app" 2>&1 | grep -Fq "TeamIdentifier=$APPLE_TEAM_ID"
            codesign -dv --verbose=4 "$app" 2>&1 | grep -Fq "Authority=Developer ID Application:"
            entitlements="$(codesign -d --entitlements - "$renderer" 2>&1)"
            grep -q 'com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit' <<<"$entitlements"
          }

          arm64_app="$(find_app_for_arch arm64)"
          x64_app="$(find_app_for_arch x86_64)"
          verify_app "$arm64_app" arm64
          verify_app "$x64_app" x86_64

      - name: Verify packaged macOS update configuration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require("node:fs");
          const path = require("node:path");

          function findUpdateConfigs(directory, matches = []) {
            for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
              const entryPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
              if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                findUpdateConfigs(entryPath, matches);
              } else if (
                entry.isFile() &&
                entry.name === "app-update.yml" &&
                entryPath
                  .split(path.sep)
                  .join("/")
                  .endsWith(".app/Contents/Resources/app-update.yml")
              ) {
                matches.push(entryPath);
              }
            }
            return matches;
          }

          function readScalar(document, key) {
            const match = document.match(
              new RegExp(`^\\s*${key}\\s*:\\s*([^#\\r\\n]+)`, "mi"),
            );
            if (!match) {
              throw new Error(`Missing ${key}`);
            }

            const value = match[1].trim();
            if (
              (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) ||
              (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))
            ) {
              return value.slice(1, -1);
            }
            return value;
          }

          function verifyUpdateConfig(file) {
            const document = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
            const [expectedOwner, expectedRepo] =
              process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY.split("/");
            const expected = {
              provider: "github",
              owner: expectedOwner,
              repo: expectedRepo,
            };

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(expected)) {
              const actual = readScalar(document, key);
              if (actual !== value) {
                throw new Error(
                  `${file}: ${key} does not match the expected release repository`,
                );
              }
            }

            const forbidden = [
              [
                "feed override field",
                /^\s*(?:channel|host|protocol|requestHeaders|url)\s*:/im,
              ],
              [
                "credential field",
                /^\s*(?:auth(?:orization)?|headers?|password|passphrase|private[-_]?token|secret|token|(?:api|access)[-_]?key|(?:gh|github)[-_]?token)\s*:/im,
              ],
              [
                "credential-bearing URL",
                /https?:\/\/[^/\s:@]+:[^@\s/]+@/i,
              ],
              [
                "authorization value",
                /\b(?:Basic|Bearer)\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/_.=-]{8,}/i,
              ],
              [
                "GitHub token",
                /\b(?:gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,})\b/i,
              ],
            ];

            for (const [label, pattern] of forbidden) {
              if (pattern.test(document)) {
                throw new Error(`${file}: contains a forbidden ${label}`);
              }
            }

            console.log(`Validated ${file}`);
          }

          const configs = findUpdateConfigs("dist").sort();
          if (configs.length !== 2) {
            throw new Error(
              `Expected two packaged macOS app-update.yml files, found ${configs.length}`,
            );
          }
          configs.forEach(verifyUpdateConfig);
          NODE

      - name: Verify macOS release artifacts and metadata
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"

          for file in \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-arm64.dmg" \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-arm64.zip" \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-x64.dmg" \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-x64.zip" \
            "dist/latest-mac.yml"; do
            test -s "$file"
          done

          node scripts/verify-update-metadata.mjs \
            dist/latest-mac.yml \
            "$version" \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-arm64.dmg" \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-arm64.zip" \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-x64.dmg" \
            "dist/Pi-Agent-Desktop-${version}-x64.zip"

      - name: Run packaged toolchain E2E for macOS arm64
        run: npm run check:packaged-toolchains -- darwin-arm64

      - name: Upload signed and notarized macOS artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: pi-desktop-macos-release
          path: |
            dist/*.dmg
            dist/*.zip
            dist/*.blockmap
            dist/latest-mac.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

        with:
          name: pi-desktop-linux-release
          path: |
            dist/*.AppImage
            dist/*.blockmap
            dist/latest-linux.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  release:
    name: Create desktop draft release
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: [release-macos, verify-macos-x64, release-windows, release-linux]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download packaged applications
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          path: release-artifacts

      - name: Create or update draft release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          files=()
          mac_artifacts="release-artifacts/pi-desktop-macos-release"
          windows_artifacts="release-artifacts/pi-desktop-windows-release"
          linux_artifacts="release-artifacts/pi-desktop-linux-release"
          test -d "$mac_artifacts"
          test -d "$windows_artifacts"
          test -d "$linux_artifacts"
          while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            files+=("$file")
          done < <(find "$mac_artifacts" "$windows_artifacts" "$linux_artifacts" -type f \( -name '*.dmg' -o -name '*.zip' -o -name '*.exe' -o -name '*.AppImage' -o -name '*.blockmap' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.cdx.json' -o -name 'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md' \) -print0)

          if [ "${#files[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No release files were downloaded" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          duplicates="$(printf '%s\n' "${files[@]##*/}" | sort | uniq -d)"
          if [ -n "$duplicates" ]; then
            echo "Duplicate release asset names:" >&2
            echo "$duplicates" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          test "$(find "$mac_artifacts" -type f -name 'latest-mac.yml' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1
          test "$(find "$windows_artifacts" -type f -name '*.exe' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1
          test "$(find "$windows_artifacts" -type f -name '*.exe.blockmap' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1
          test "$(find "$windows_artifacts" -type f -name 'latest.yml' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1
          test "$(find "$windows_artifacts" -type f -name '*.cdx.json' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1
          test "$(find "$windows_artifacts" -type f -name 'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1
          test "$(find "$linux_artifacts" -type f -name '*.AppImage' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1
          test "$(find "$linux_artifacts" -type f -name 'latest-linux.yml' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1

          if is_draft="$(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null)"; then
            if [ "$is_draft" != "true" ]; then
              echo "Release $GITHUB_REF_NAME is already public; published assets are immutable" >&2
              exit 1
            fi

            declare -A expected_assets=()
            for file in "${files[@]}"; do
              expected_assets["${file##*/}"]=1
            done
            while IFS= read -r existing_asset; do
              if [ -n "$existing_asset" ] && [ -z "${expected_assets[$existing_asset]+present}" ]; then
                echo "Removing stale draft asset: $existing_asset"
                gh release delete-asset "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$existing_asset" --yes
              fi
            done < <(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name')

            gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${files[@]}" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${files[@]}" --draft --generate-notes --verify-tag
          fi
